items.title: Unlocking Programmable and Creative RNA Sequence Design with RDiffusion
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract RNA, a pillar of the central dogma, has shaped three billion years of evolution. Despite cataloging tens of millions of non-coding RNAs and annotating millions, we have barely scratched the surface of the vast, unexplored RNA sequence space. Here, we introduce RDiffusion, a discrete-diffusion-based generative transformer model for RNA sequence design. Conditioned on diverse biological features, such as desired function, family type, secondary and tertiary structure, or binding protein partners, it can guide the generation of novel RNA sequences tailored to specific design specifications. We evaluate RDiffusion across a broad spectrum of RNA design tasks and find that it not only surpasses all baseline methods in design success rate and sequence diversity but also achieves advanced performance on downstream tasks. To demonstrate its translational potential, we applied RDiffusion with a customized seed-screening pipeline to de novo design therapeutic MicroRNA(miRNA) mimics in osteoarthritis (OA). This strategy identified mimic 0-4 as a lead candidate targeting SDC4 to preserve ECM homeostasis and cartilage integrity, with robust efficacy validated in clinical OA samples. Altogether, RDiffusion holds strong potential to serve as a cornerstone for RNA generation and representation learning, establishing a generalizable AI-driven paradigm for RNA therapeutic discovery.
items.summary_zh: RDiffusion 以离散扩散生成 Transformer 按功能、家族、结构或结合蛋白条件设计 RNA，并在骨关节炎临床样本中报告了 miRNA 候选物的验证结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将可控 RNA 生成与疾病相关候选物筛选相连；但其治疗转化结论仍来自 preprint 中报告的临床样本验证。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 RNA 是中心法则的支柱，塑造了三十亿年的演化。尽管我们已编目数千万条非编码 RNA 并注释了数百万条 RNA，我们对广阔而未探索的 RNA 序列空间仍仅触及表面。本文提出 RDiffusion：一种用于 RNA 序列设计、基于离散扩散的生成式 Transformer 模型。该模型可根据多样的生物学特征进行条件化，例如所需功能、家族类型、二级和三级结构或结合蛋白伙伴，从而引导生成符合特定设计要求的新型 RNA 序列。我们在广泛的 RNA 设计任务中评估 RDiffusion，发现其不仅在设计成功率和序列多样性上超过所有基线方法，也在下游任务中取得先进性能。为展示其转化潜力，我们将 RDiffusion 与定制化种子筛选流程结合，用于从头设计治疗骨关节炎（OA）的 MicroRNA（miRNA）模拟物。该策略识别出以 SDC4 为靶点、用于维持 ECM 稳态和软骨完整性的候选先导物 mimic 0-4，并在临床 OA 样本中验证了稳健疗效。总体而言，RDiffusion 具有成为 RNA 生成和表征学习基石的强大潜力，并为 RNA 治疗发现建立一种可泛化的 AI 驱动范式。
items.author_line: Wang J, Dong J, Yang L, Li T, Yin J, Chen J, Dong Y, Li J, Tan C

items.title: spaGFM is a scalable graph foundation model for spatial transcriptomics analyses
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Foundation models offer a promising paradigm for modeling spatial transcriptomics, but capturing tissue context over cellular graphs makes training at scale challenging. We introduce spaGFM, a graph foundation model that serializes cellular neighborhoods through random walks to generate transformer-compatible representations of tissue organization. By replacing classical graph message passing with augmented self-supervised neighborhood reconstruction, spaGFM captures higher-order spatial context while allowing scaling at the atlas level. Pretrained on 43.9 million cells from 132 image-based spatial transcriptomics datasets, spaGFM produces robust representations at both the neighborhood and cell level that transfer across tissues, disease contexts, and spatial technologies. SpaGFM identifies tertiary lymphoid structures across cancer cohorts and spatial platforms, captures cell-level transcriptomic perturbation responses associated with T cell vicinity in spatial CRISPR experiments, and characterizes glomerular organization associated with pathological grade in diabetic kidney disease biopsies. Overall, spaGFM establishes a graph foundation-model framework for learning cellular organization and its functional consequences.
items.summary_zh: spaGFM 用随机游走序列化细胞邻域，在 132 个空间转录组数据集的 4,390 万细胞上预训练图基础模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其数据规模和跨组织、疾病及技术迁移评估突出，且将空间组织表征与肿瘤 TLS、空间 CRISPR 和糖尿病肾病分析相连。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 基础模型为建模空间转录组学提供了有前景的范式，但通过细胞图捕获组织背景使大规模训练面临挑战。我们提出 spaGFM：一种图基础模型，它通过随机游走将细胞邻域序列化，从而生成与 Transformer 兼容的组织结构表征。spaGFM 以增强的自监督邻域重建取代经典图消息传递，在能够按图谱尺度扩展的同时捕获高阶空间背景。spaGFM 在来自 132 个基于图像的空间转录组数据集的 4,390 万个细胞上预训练，在邻域和细胞两个层面产生稳健表征，可跨组织、疾病背景和空间技术迁移。SpaGFM 跨癌症队列和空间平台识别三级淋巴结构，在空间 CRISPR 实验中捕捉与 T 细胞邻近相关的细胞水平转录组扰动反应，并刻画糖尿病肾病活检中与病理分级相关的肾小球组织。总体而言，spaGFM 建立了一个用于学习细胞组织及其功能后果的图基础模型框架。
items.author_line: Wang J, Zhong Y, He F, Jin X, Yu Y, Ferreira RM, Gunderson A, Krull J, Wang G, Eadon M, Ma Q, Xu D

items.title: Identifying cohorts at elevated risk of cancers using generative modeling of patient health states
items.abstract_or_text: While large language models are powerful generators of new text, forecasting disease progression from longitudinal health histories remains a challenging problem. We introduce GenEHR, an autoregressive generative model trained on electronic health records (EHRs) from millions of patients that explicitly represents the irregular time intervals between visits when forecasting future clinical events. We combine the general-purpose patient representation learned during foundational training with parameter-efficient supervised adaptation for the task of pan-cancer risk stratification. In five large EHR cohorts supervised adaptation substantially improved prediction performance of a first cancer diagnosis within a five year horizon window. Our retrospective results support the evaluation of GenEHR-CancerRisk as a prospective clinical decision-support tool for prioritizing patients for risk-based screening for aggressive cancer types, such as pancreatic and ovarian cancer.
items.summary_zh: GenEHR 在数百万患者的 EHR 上训练自回归生成模型，并在五个大型 EHR 队列中以监督适配改善五年内首次癌症诊断风险分层。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 纵向、时间不规则的真实世界 EHR 建模具有较高临床研究价值；摘要明确将结果限定为回顾性结果，并支持未来前瞻性评估。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管大语言模型是强大的新文本生成器，但基于纵向健康病史预测疾病进展仍是一个挑战性问题。我们提出 GenEHR：一个在数百万患者电子健康记录（EHR）上训练的自回归生成模型；在预测未来临床事件时，该模型明确表征就诊之间不规则的时间间隔。我们将基础训练中学习到的通用患者表征，与针对泛癌风险分层任务的参数高效监督适配相结合。在五个大型 EHR 队列中，监督适配显著提升了五年预测窗口内首次癌症诊断的预测性能。我们的回顾性结果支持将 GenEHR-CancerRisk 作为前瞻性临床决策支持工具进行评估，以便为侵袭性癌种（如胰腺癌和卵巢癌）的基于风险筛查确定患者优先级。
items.author_line: Khan, A., Forster, D. T., Harsh, M., Zheng, C., Warner, E. T., Ritter, D., Chang, A., Wei, Q., Sorensen, T. K., Marks, D. S., Sequist, L. V., Hadlock, J. J., Fillmore, N. R., Sander, C.

items.title: Spatially resolved multimodal hallmarks of response to neoadjuvant immunotherapies in the melanoma ecosystem in 2D and 3D
items.abstract_or_text: Neoadjuvant immunotherapy has transformed cancer treatment, yet the spatial molecular architecture governing response and resistance across distinct immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) regimens remains poorly defined. We assembled the largest neoadjuvant ICB (NICB) spatial multi-omics cohort to date, profiling over 112 million cells at single-cell resolution across three melanoma ICB regimens using MERFISH spatial transcriptomics, multiplexed immunofluorescence, and scRNA-sequencing. These analyses revealed the full multicellular spatial architecture of the NICB tumor microenvironment, including mature TLS with germinal centers, TCF7+ stem-like T cells, myeloid cells organized into spatially distinct cellular neighborhoods with unique intercellular signaling circuits, and CCL19/CCL21-expressing fibroblasts as a previously unrecognized stromal scaffold sustaining these immune hubs. We developed three purpose-built computational tools that together enabled comprehensive quantification of this microenvironment for the first time: SCIRA for whole-slide single-cell receptor-ligand quantification, GCSCAN for molecularly grounded TLS and germinal center structural delineation, and PathNet-TLS for automated TLS detection on H&E images. Applying these tools across the cohort, we defined the immune and stromal composition and cellular neighborhood organization distinguishing responders from non-responders. We also quantified cell-cell interactions and regimen-specific immune architectures, including a markedly stronger mature TLS/germinal center response with IPI-NIVO than NIVO-RELA. Importantly, GCSCAN-quantified TLS and germinal center density each stratified disease-free survival, with responders that lack germinal centers having an elevated risk of relapse. Open-top light-sheet imaging and CODA-based 3D reconstruction further uncovered interconnected germinal center-TLS tunnels invisible to standard 2D histopathology. These findings establish a discovery-to-tool paradigm linking single-cell tumor microenvironment interrogation to clinically deployable computational pathology for biomarker-driven NICB assessment across cancer types.
items.summary_zh: 该研究构建新辅助 ICB 空间多组学队列，分析超过 1.12 亿个单细胞，并开发 TLS 定量和病理检测工具以关联应答与无病生存。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模临床相关空间多组学与 2D/3D 成像结合，能够将肿瘤微环境发现推进到可检验的病理生物标志物。
items.abstract_zh: 新辅助免疫治疗改变了癌症治疗，但在不同免疫检查点阻断（ICB）方案中决定应答和耐药的空间分子结构仍缺乏清晰界定。我们组建了迄今最大的、新辅助 ICB（NICB）空间多组学队列，使用 MERFISH 空间转录组学、多重免疫荧光和 scRNA-sequencing，对三种黑色素瘤 ICB 方案中超过 1.12 亿个细胞进行单细胞分辨率分析。这些分析揭示了 NICB 肿瘤微环境完整的多细胞空间结构，包括具有生发中心的成熟 TLS、TCF7+ 干样 T 细胞、组织成具有独特细胞间信号回路的空间不同细胞邻域的髓系细胞，以及作为维持这些免疫枢纽的此前未被认识到的基质支架的表达 CCL19/CCL21 的成纤维细胞。我们开发了三种专门构建的计算工具，首次共同实现了对此微环境的全面定量：用于全切片单细胞受体-配体定量的 SCIRA、用于以分子为基础界定 TLS 和生发中心结构的 GCSCAN，以及用于在 H&E 图像上自动检测 TLS 的 PathNet-TLS。将这些工具应用于整个队列后，我们界定了区分应答者和非应答者的免疫及基质组成和细胞邻域组织。我们还定量了细胞-细胞相互作用和方案特异性免疫结构，包括 IPI-NIVO 相比 NIVO-RELA 明显更强的成熟 TLS/生发中心反应。重要的是，经 GCSCAN 定量的 TLS 和生发中心密度均可分层无病生存；缺乏生发中心的应答者复发风险升高。开放式顶部光片成像和基于 CODA 的 3D 重建进一步发现了标准 2D 组织病理学无法观察到的相互连接的生发中心-TLS 隧道。这些发现建立了一种从发现到工具的范式，将单细胞肿瘤微环境解析连接到可临床部署的计算病理学，用于跨癌种的生物标志物驱动 NICB 评估。

items.title: USP2 safeguards retinal homeostasis by stabilizing macrophage PD-L1 to restrain CD8⁺ T cell cytotoxicity in age-related macular degeneration
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is driven by chronic oxidative injury and immune dysregulation within the retinal microenvironment, yet the post-translational mechanisms governing immune homeostasis remain incompletely understood. Deubiquitinating enzymes (DUBs) have emerged as critical regulators of protein stability, but their roles in retinal immunity and AMD pathogenesis have not been systematically explored. Results Through integrated bioinformatic and experimental screening, we identified ubiquitin-specific protease 2 (USP2) as a retina-enriched DUB that is consistently downregulated in AMD patients, oxidative stress-induced murine models, and aged retinas, with depletion most pronounced in the synaptic plexiform layers and the RPE/choroid interface—regions critical for immune regulation. Genetic ablation of Usp2 exacerbated RPE damage and retinal degeneration following oxidative injury, whereas USP2 overexpression conferred robust protection. Mechanistically, USP2 directly bound to PD-L1 on retinal macrophages and removed its ubiquitin chains, thereby preventing proteasomal degradation and sustaining PD-L1 surface expression. Loss of USP2 destabilized macrophage PD-L1, which unleashed CD8⁺ cytotoxic T lymphocyte infiltration and activation, driving RPE injury through macrophage–T cell crosstalk. Critically, pharmacological activation of the PD-1 inhibitory pathway with peresolimab effectively attenuated oxidative damage, preserved RPE integrity, and recapitulated the protective effects of USP2 augmentation. Conclusions The USP2–PD-L1 axis constitutes a previously unrecognized antioxidant immune checkpoint that couples redox stress to adaptive immune suppression within the retina. Oxidative stress-induced disruption of this deubiquitination-dependent checkpoint emerges as a critical driver of AMD progression, positioning USP2 and its downstream PD-L1/PD-1 pathway as promising immunomodulatory targets for therapeutic intervention in degenerative retinal diseases.
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出 USP2 通过稳定视网膜巨噬细胞 PD-L1 限制 CD8⁺ T 细胞细胞毒性，并在氧化应激模型中测试 PD-1 通路激活。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把去泛素化、免疫检查点和 AMD 视网膜微环境联系起来，具有机制与干预两层证据；但仍为 preprint 的患者样本和模型研究。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）由视网膜微环境内的慢性氧化损伤和免疫失调驱动，但调控免疫稳态的翻译后机制仍未被充分理解。去泛素化酶（DUB）已成为蛋白质稳定性的关键调节因子，但其在视网膜免疫和 AMD 发病机制中的作用尚未得到系统探索。结果 通过整合生物信息学和实验筛选，我们鉴定出泛素特异性蛋白酶 2（USP2），它是一种在视网膜中富集的 DUB，在 AMD 患者、氧化应激诱导的小鼠模型和老化视网膜中均持续下调；其耗竭在突触丛状层和 RPE/脉络膜界面最为显著，这些区域对免疫调控至关重要。Usp2 的遗传消除加重了氧化损伤后的 RPE 损伤和视网膜退变，而 USP2 过表达则提供了稳健保护。在机制上，USP2 直接结合视网膜巨噬细胞上的 PD-L1 并去除其泛素链，从而阻止蛋白酶体降解并维持 PD-L1 的表面表达。USP2 缺失使巨噬细胞 PD-L1 不稳定，继而释放 CD8⁺ 细胞毒性 T 淋巴细胞的浸润和活化，并通过巨噬细胞-T 细胞串扰驱动 RPE 损伤。关键的是，使用 peresolimab 对 PD-1 抑制性通路进行药理学激活，可有效减轻氧化损伤、维持 RPE 完整性，并重现增强 USP2 的保护效应。结论 USP2–PD-L1 轴构成一个此前未被认识到的抗氧化免疫检查点，将氧化还原应激与视网膜内的适应性免疫抑制相耦联。氧化应激诱导的这一依赖去泛素化的检查点破坏，成为 AMD 进展的关键驱动因素，使 USP2 及其下游 PD-L1/PD-1 通路成为退行性视网膜疾病中有前景的免疫调节治疗靶点。
items.author_line: Zhou L, Li C, Liao T, Luo T, Sun H, Wang Y, Lin H, Zhang J, Yang S, Yang M

items.title: 3D Segmentation of Pathological Muscle with a Physics-Informed Latent-Regularized U-Net
items.abstract_or_text: Objective: We developed a data-efficient deep learning framework for three-dimensional segmentation of pathological musculoskeletal anatomy from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) when only limited manual annotations are available. Methods: We developed a Physics-Informed Latent-Regularized U-Net (PILR-U-Net) that combines transfer learning from healthy MRI, latent-space anatomical regularization, and elasticity-based physics-informed constraints. The physics-informed loss enforces mechanical equilibrium, near-incompressibility, and spatial smoothness of predicted deformation fields. The framework was evaluated on MRI datasets from 50 participants with cerebral palsy across 15 lower-limb musculoskeletal structures using sparse manual annotations. Performance was assessed using volumetric overlap, boundary accuracy, volume error, sensitivity, and precision. Ablation experiments evaluated the individual contributions of latent-space and physics-informed regularization. Results: Our experimental results show accurate segmentations with three-dimensional Dice coefficients ranging from 0.750 to 0.943 across evaluated structures, while most structures exhibited low surface-distance errors. Predicted deformation fields maintained positive Jacobian determinants near unity and smooth strain-energy distributions. Ablation analysis showed that both regularization components improved performance, with removal of physics-informed regularization producing the largest reductions in Dice accuracy and increases in boundary error. Conclusion: PILR-U-Net enables accurate and anatomically plausible segmentation of pathological musculoskeletal MRI under sparse supervision. Significance: Incorporating anatomical priors and biomechanical constraints into deep segmentation networks may reduce dependence on extensive pathological annotations and support patient-specific musculoskeletal modeling and clinical analysis.
items.summary_zh: PILR-U-Net 将迁移学习、潜在空间解剖正则化和生物力学约束结合，在 50 名脑瘫参与者的 MRI 中进行稀疏标注三维肌骨分割。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作针对临床病理影像标注稀缺问题，提供了量化结果、物理合理性检查与消融分析，但仍需在独立临床场景验证。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：当仅有有限人工标注可用时，我们开发了一个数据高效的深度学习框架，用于从磁共振成像（MRI）中对病理性肌肉骨骼解剖结构进行三维分割。方法：我们开发了 Physics-Informed Latent-Regularized U-Net（PILR-U-Net），它结合了来自健康 MRI 的迁移学习、潜在空间解剖正则化和基于弹性的物理信息约束。物理信息损失强制预测形变场满足机械平衡、近不可压缩性和空间平滑性。该框架在来自 50 名脑瘫参与者的 MRI 数据集上评估，覆盖 15 个下肢肌肉骨骼结构，并使用稀疏人工标注。使用体积重叠、边界准确性、体积误差、敏感性和精确性评估性能。消融实验评估了潜在空间正则化和物理信息正则化各自的贡献。结果：我们的实验结果显示，在所评估结构中，三维 Dice 系数为 0.750 至 0.943，而大多数结构表现出较低的表面距离误差。预测的形变场保持接近 1 的正 Jacobian 行列式和光滑的应变能分布。消融分析显示，两种正则化组件均改善性能；去除物理信息正则化导致 Dice 准确性下降最大，且边界误差增加。结论：PILR-U-Net 在稀疏监督下能够对病理性肌肉骨骼 MRI 实现准确且解剖上合理的分割。意义：将解剖先验和生物力学约束纳入深度分割网络，可能减少对大量病理标注的依赖，并支持患者特异性肌肉骨骼建模和临床分析。
items.author_line: Mehrabi, N., Pegard, N. C. R., Handsfield, G. G.

items.title: dubTAGs enable on-demand stabilization for tunable and reversible control of endogenous protein levels
items.abstract_or_text: Precise and rapid control over cellular protein levels is essential to dissect complex biological systems. Chemical genetic approaches such as dTAG, in which a target is fused to a degron tag (FKBP12F36V) and degraded upon small molecule-mediated recruitment of E3 ligases, have enabled rapid and tunable control over protein abundance. However, no analogous tool exists to precisely increase protein levels and actively reverse dTAG-mediated degradation. Here, we developed heterobifunctional small molecules (dubTAGs) that stabilize FKBP12F36V-tagged proteins by recruiting endogenous deubiquitinases. Utilizing stem cell-derived cranial neural crest cells (CNCCs) in which the transcription factors SOX9 or TWIST1 are endogenously tagged with FKBP12F36V, we identified OTUB1- or USP7-recruiting heterobifunctional molecules that demonstrated effective target stabilization and ternary complex formation. We demonstrate that dubTAG-mediated protein stabilization is dependent on deubiquitinase recruitment, target-specific, and can tunably and rapidly reverse dTAG-mediated degradation. We applied dubTAGs to assess how stabilizing endogenous SOX9 impacts chromatin accessibility in CNCCs, finding both monotonic and non-monotonic regulatory element responses that are driven by distinct sequence features. dubTAGs are readily applicable tools for investigating the effects of elevated protein levels and tunably reversing targeted degradation, enabling new approaches to study protein dosage effects in development, disease, and therapeutic discovery.
items.summary_zh: dubTAGs 通过招募内源性去泛素化酶稳定 FKBP12F36V 标记蛋白，使 dTAG 介导的降解可被快速、可逆且可调地逆转。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一种可操作蛋白剂量的新化学生物学工具，并在干细胞来源 CNCCs 中用于连接 SOX9 稳定化与染色质可及性变化。
evidence_flags: 靶标稳定化与可逆降解
items.abstract_zh: 对细胞蛋白水平进行精确且快速的控制，对于解析复杂生物系统至关重要。化学遗传学方法，例如 dTAG，可将靶标与降解子标签（FKBP12F36V）融合，并通过小分子介导招募 E3 连接酶使其降解，已经能够对蛋白丰度进行快速且可调的控制。然而，目前尚无可精确提高蛋白水平并主动逆转 dTAG 介导降解的类似工具。本文开发了异双功能小分子（dubTAGs），其通过招募内源性去泛素化酶来稳定带有 FKBP12F36V 标签的蛋白。利用内源性标记 FKBP12F36V 的转录因子 SOX9 或 TWIST1 的干细胞来源颅神经嵴细胞（CNCCs），我们鉴定出招募 OTUB1 或 USP7 的异双功能分子，它们表现出有效的靶标稳定化和三元复合物形成。我们证明，dubTAG 介导的蛋白稳定化依赖于去泛素化酶招募、具有靶标特异性，并可调节且快速地逆转 dTAG 介导的降解。我们将 dubTAGs 用于评估稳定内源性 SOX9 如何影响 CNCCs 中的染色质可及性，发现了由不同序列特征驱动的单调和非单调调控元件反应。dubTAGs 是易于应用的工具，可用于研究蛋白水平升高的效应以及可调地逆转靶向降解，为在发育、疾病和治疗发现中研究蛋白剂量效应提供新方法。
items.author_line: Guharajan, S., Song, X., Wu, Q., Sengupta, S., Wei, W., Xiong, Y., Jin, J., Naqvi, S.

items.title: Accelerated discovery of thermostable vaccines using data-efficient AI
items.abstract_or_text: The inherent instability of mRNA- lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) necessitates ultra-cold storage, creating significant barriers for global distribution and limiting their broader application in advanced delivery systems. Solid-state, water-free formulations offer a promising solution by enhancing thermostability and enabling integration into emerging delivery modalities such as microneedle (MN) patches. Prior efforts to stabilize mRNA-LNPs have been constrained by narrow formulation scope and low-throughput screening methods. Here, we introduce AGENT (Algorithm-Guided Experimental design for lipid Nanoparticle Thermostabilization), an AI-driven framework that couples high-throughput experimentation with Bayesian optimization to rapidly identify thermostable mRNA-LNP formulations. Manual exploration of the formulation space required months of screening and yielded suboptimal candidates. In contrast, AGENT extracted maximal information from sparse experimental datasets, enabling efficient formulation optimization in only six iterations completed within one month. Using AGENT, we stabilized mRNA vaccines with diverse LNPs, including those in clinical use, into solid state formulations that retained 100% bioactivity after storage at 37 degree C for over two months. The thermostable vaccines induced antigen-specific IgG and germinal center B cell responses that were non-inferior to those elicited by freshly prepared soluble vaccines. The solid-state formulations were further incorporated into dissolvable MN patches and administered to rodents and nonhuman primates, yielding comparable neutralizing antibody titers compared to conventional intramuscular delivery of fresh vaccines. To our knowledge, this study presents the first demonstration of AI-driven design of thermostable RNA vaccines, offering a scalable, cold-chain-free solution for global immunization. By addressing both stability and delivery challenges, AGENT provides a potentially transformative platform for developing accessible next-generation therapeutics.
items.summary_zh: AGENT 以高通量实验和贝叶斯优化筛选热稳定 mRNA-LNP 固态配方，并在啮齿类和非人灵长类中报告免疫原性结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究把数据高效优化与真实配方、长期稳定性和多种动物给药验证结合；使用临床 LNP 不等同于临床试验证据。
items.abstract_zh: mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）的固有不稳定性要求超低温储存，给全球分发造成重大障碍，并限制其在先进递送系统中的更广泛应用。固态无水配方通过增强热稳定性并使其能够整合进微针（MN）贴片等新兴递送模式，提供了一个有前景的解决方案。此前稳定 mRNA-LNP 的工作受到配方范围狭窄和低通量筛选方法的限制。本文提出 AGENT（Algorithm-Guided Experimental design for lipid Nanoparticle Thermostabilization）：一个 AI 驱动框架，将高通量实验与贝叶斯优化相结合，以快速识别热稳定 mRNA-LNP 配方。对配方空间进行人工探索需要数月筛选，且得到的候选物并不理想。相比之下，AGENT 从稀疏实验数据集中提取最大信息量，只用在一个月内完成的六轮迭代便实现了高效配方优化。使用 AGENT，我们将具有不同 LNP 的 mRNA 疫苗（包括临床使用的 LNP）稳定为固态配方；在 37 degree C 下储存超过两个月后，这些配方仍保留 100% 生物活性。热稳定疫苗诱导的抗原特异性 IgG 和生发中心 B 细胞反应，不劣于新鲜制备的可溶性疫苗所诱导的反应。固态配方还被整合进可溶解 MN 贴片，并施用于啮齿类和非人灵长类；与新鲜疫苗的常规肌内递送相比，产生了可比的中和抗体滴度。据我们所知，本研究首次展示了热稳定 RNA 疫苗的 AI 驱动设计，为全球免疫提供了一个可扩展、无需冷链的解决方案。通过同时应对稳定性和递送挑战，AGENT 为开发可及的下一代治疗方法提供了一个可能具有变革性的平​​台。
items.author_line: Tian, J., Tran, K. T. M., Pogostin, B. H., Sheridan, O., Mursalova, S., Lee, A. H., Liu, S., Hamkins, J., Antov, D., Power, A. L., Dash, Z. S., Yun, D., Konakovic Lukovic, M., Langer, R., Jaklenec, A.

items.title: An atlas of transcription factor cooperation reveals how motif readers shape regulatory output
items.abstract_or_text: Regulatory motifs are conventionally associated with named transcription factors (TFs), yet a motif label need not identify the protein that reads the sequence or the regulatory consequence that follows in a given cell. We analyzed 1,552 TF binding datasets in 10 cell types using ARES, a multi-agent system that tests competing mechanisms of TF-motif dependencies in a specific cellular context against multi-omic data. We found that the inferred mechanisms converged on three operating routes: direct sequence recognition, protein-mediated recruitment or exclusion, and regulatory context. Importantly, the predictive motifs of the target TF binding were read by their conventionally "canonical" TFs in only one third of resolved dependencies, and these "canonical" TFs were expressed much less often than the inferred readers. Furthermore, we observed that motif similarity was associated with shared regulatory region type but not shared transcriptional outcome, whereas reader identity was associated with both and the only feature among the examined associated with outcome. In validation case studies where an inferred reader was perturbed, target TF occupancy fell in proportion to reader binding before perturbation, and a natural variant disrupting the predictive motif altered target TF binding at every intermediate step of the inferred mechanism. These observations were further supported by single-cell perturbation, in vitro cooperativity and evolutionary constraint. Together, these results separate motif identity from reader identity and regulatory output, suggesting that a motif acts as an address whose regulatory consequence is shaped in trans by the protein that interprets it.
items.summary_zh: ARES 多智能体系统分析 10 种细胞类型的 1,552 个 TF 结合数据集，提出基序读取者身份而非基序标签更能关联调控输出。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究以多组学、扰动、体外协同和进化约束交叉支持其机制推断，为解释细胞语境中的 TF-基序依赖提供了可检验框架。
items.abstract_zh: 调控基序通常与具名转录因子（TF）相关联，但基序标签不必能指认在给定细胞中读取该序列的蛋白，或随后发生的调控后果。我们使用 ARES 分析了 10 种细胞类型中的 1,552 个 TF 结合数据集。ARES 是一个多智能体系统，可针对特定细胞背景中的多组学数据检验 TF-基序依赖关系的竞争机制。我们发现，推断出的机制汇聚为三条作用路径：直接序列识别、蛋白介导的招募或排斥，以及调控背景。重要的是，在已解析依赖关系中，靶 TF 结合的预测性基序只有三分之一由其传统上“经典”的 TF 读取，而这些“经典”TF 的表达频率远低于推断出的读取者。此外，我们观察到，基序相似性与共享的调控区域类型相关，但不与共享的转录输出相关；而读取者身份则同时与二者相关，并且是在所考察特征中唯一与输出相关的特征。在对推断读取者进行扰动的验证案例研究中，靶 TF 占据随扰动前读取者结合程度的增加而下降；一个破坏预测性基序的自然变异，则在推断机制的每一个中间步骤改变了靶 TF 结合。单细胞扰动、体外协同性和进化约束进一步支持了这些观察。总体而言，这些结果将基序身份与读取者身份及调控输出区分开来，提示基序如同一个地址，其调控后果由在反式作用的、解释该地址的蛋白所塑造。
items.author_line: Xiong, H., Liu, J., Wang, W.

items.title: p53 knockout drives stage-specific long non-coding RNA reprogramming during human neural differentiation and glioma organoid tumorigenesis.
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are emerging regulators of tumor initiation and progression through their effects on stemness, lineage commitment, and transcriptional plasticity. The contribution of lncRNA reprogramming during early p53-deficient gliomagenesis remains poorly understood. Methods: Human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) carrying a complete TP53 knockout were differentiated into neural progenitor cells (NPCs) and cerebral organoids. Bulk RNA sequencing was performed at multiple differentiation stages and compared with established glioblastoma cell lines (U87 and U118) to identify lncRNA expression changes associated with p53 loss and tumor-like transformation. Results: p53 deficiency induced a progressive and stage-specific remodeling of the lncRNA landscape, with the most pronounced transcriptional shift observed in 40-day NPCs. This late-stage profile partially overlapped with glioblastoma-like cell lines and was characterized by the upregulation of five lncRNAs enriched in both p53-deficient neural models and glioma cells. Principal component analysis showed that these lncRNAs clustered with tumor-associated samples and were strongly co-expressed with mitotic cell-cycle genes. In particular, LINC00973 and LINC01583 were highly expressed in primary glioblastoma datasets, while RP5-875H18.9 and RP11-1094H24.4 emerged as previously unrecognized glioma-associated transcripts. Conclusion: Loss of p53 drives stage-dependent lncRNA reprogramming during neural differentiation and promotes the emergence of glioma-associated transcriptional features. These findings identify candidate lncRNAs that may contribute to early gliomagenesis and represent potential biomarkers or therapeutic targets in glioblastoma.
items.summary_zh: TP53 完全敲除的 iPSC 神经分化和脑类器官模型显示阶段特异性 lncRNA 重编程，并提出与胶质母细胞瘤相关的候选转录本。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究把发育阶段 RNA-seq、类器官和胶质母细胞瘤细胞系比较结合，但候选 lncRNA 的致病功能仍需直接扰动验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：长非编码 RNA（lncRNA）通过影响干性、谱系承诺和转录可塑性，正成为肿瘤起始和进展的调节因子。在早期 p53 缺陷性胶质瘤发生过程中，lncRNA 重编程的贡献仍知之甚少。方法：将携带完全 TP53 敲除的人诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）分化为神经祖细胞（NPCs）和脑类器官。在多个分化阶段进行 bulk RNA sequencing，并与已建立的胶质母细胞瘤细胞系（U87 和 U118）比较，以识别与 p53 缺失和肿瘤样转化相关的 lncRNA 表达变化。结果：p53 缺陷诱导 lncRNA 图谱进行性且阶段特异性的重塑，最显著的转录变化出现在 40 天的 NPCs 中。该晚期特征与胶质母细胞瘤样细胞系部分重叠，其特征是 5 条 lncRNA 上调；这些 lncRNA 同时富集于 p53 缺陷神经模型和胶质瘤细胞。主成分分析显示，这些 lncRNA 与肿瘤相关样本聚类，并与有丝分裂细胞周期基因强烈共表达。特别是，LINC00973 和 LINC01583 在原发性胶质母细胞瘤数据集中高表达，而 RP5-875H18.9 和 RP11-1094H24.4 则成为此前未被认识到的胶质瘤相关转录本。结论：p53 缺失在神经分化期间驱动阶段依赖性的 lncRNA 重编程，并促进胶质瘤相关转录特征的出现。这些发现鉴定出可能有助于早期胶质瘤发生的候选 lncRNA，并代表胶质母细胞瘤中潜在的生物标志物或治疗靶点。
items.author_line: Stasi, F., Manzari, A. R., Siciliano, V., Binda, E., Pazienza, V., Brunetti, V., De Vittorio, M.

items.title: Deep learning-based assessment of ulcerative colitis activity from full-length endoscopic videos with spatial characterisation and histological correlation
items.abstract_or_text: Background and study aims: Endoscopic assessment of ulcerative colitis (UC) is central to clinical decision-making however remains subjective and limited in characterisation of disease distribution. Artificial intelligence (AI) enables analysis of entire endoscopic examination, rather than relying on selected views. We aimed to develop and validate a deep learning model for automated assessment of UC severity from full-length endoscopic videos, introducing spatial representation of inflammation (Continuous Disease Score, CDS), and assess histological correlation. Patients and methods: Full-length endoscopy videos from adult patients with UC undergoing colonoscopy or flexible sigmoidoscopy were analysed; isolated proctitis was excluded. Videos were segmented and annotated using Mayo Endoscopic Score (MES) and Ulcerative Colitis Endoscopic Index of Activity (UCEIS). A deep learning model was trained for frame-level quality control and severity prediction, enabling analysis of full-length videos. Performance was evaluated using quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) and Cohen's kappa, with patient-level separation between datasets. CDS was derived from UCEIS predictions to quantify cumulative inflammatory burden, spatial extent of disease and histological prediction. Results: A total of 67 videos from 59 patients were included. The model demonstrated agreement for remission classification (MES=0 {kappa} 0.76; UCEIS[≤]1 {kappa} 0.84). CDS enabled quantification of inflammatory burden and revealed spatial heterogeneity not reflected in categorical scores. Agreement with histology was strong (AUROC 0.84-0.87). Conclusions: AI-based analysis enables automated assessment of UC activity from full-length endoscopic videos, including remission detection and estimation of histological healing. CDS provides continuous characterisation of inflammatory burden and disease extent beyond conventional categorical scores, with potential to support more standardised assessment in clinical trials and practice.
items.summary_zh: 该深度学习模型以完整 UC 内镜视频进行逐帧活动度评估，并以 Continuous Disease Score 表征炎症负荷、范围和组织学关联。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 完整视频而非选帧分析更贴近临床检查流程；但研究仅含 67 段视频、59 名患者，仍应视为需外部验证的临床研究模型。
items.abstract_zh: 背景和研究目的：溃疡性结肠炎（UC）的内镜评估是临床决策的核心，但其仍具有主观性，且对疾病分布的表征有限。人工智能（AI）能够分析完整内镜检查，而非依赖选定视图。我们的目标是开发并验证一个用于从完整内镜视频自动评估 UC 严重程度的深度学习模型，引入炎症的空间表征（Continuous Disease Score，CDS），并评估其与组织学的相关性。患者和方法：分析接受结肠镜检查或软式乙状结肠镜检查的成人 UC 患者的完整内镜视频；排除孤立性直肠炎。视频使用 Mayo Endoscopic Score（MES）和 Ulcerative Colitis Endoscopic Index of Activity（UCEIS）进行分段和标注。训练一个深度学习模型进行逐帧质量控制和严重程度预测，从而能够分析完整视频。使用二次加权 kappa（QWK）和 Cohen's kappa 评估性能，并在患者层面划分数据集。CDS 由 UCEIS 预测结果推导，以量化累积炎症负荷、疾病空间范围和组织学预测。结果：共纳入来自 59 名患者的 67 段视频。该模型在缓解分类上表现出一致性（MES=0，κ=0.76；UCEIS≤1，κ=0.84）。CDS 能够量化炎症负荷，并揭示分类评分未反映的空间异质性。与组织学的一致性很强（AUROC 0.84–0.87）。结论：基于 AI 的分析可从完整内镜视频自动评估 UC 活动度，包括缓解检测和组织学愈合估计。CDS 提供了超越传统分类评分的、对炎症负荷和疾病范围的连续表征，具有支持临床试验和实践中更标准化评估的潜力。
items.author_line: Bogush, A., Toskas, A., Ralli, G., Windell, D., Aljabar, P., DeLegge, M., Walsh, A., Thomas, J. P., Wakefield, P., Langford, C., Fryer, E., Goldin, R., Suzuki, N., Landy, J.

items.title: OpenLipid: a large language model workflow for targeted analysis of DIA mass spectrometry data in lipidomics
items.abstract_or_text: Mass spectrometry has become a central technology for lipidomics, with data-independent acquisition (DIA) enabling broad and reproducible sampling of lipid signals. However, the multiplexed fragment-ion spectra in DIA data complicate lipid identification. Here, we introduce OpenLipid, a large language model (LLM)-based workflow for targeted DIA lipidomics. Using assay libraries built from data-dependent acquisition (DDA) results, OpenLipid directly evaluates extracted ion chromatograms (XICs) from DIA data in a zero-shot setting to identify target lipid peaks and generate human-readable rationales for individual lipid identification decisions. We benchmarked OpenLipid against manual annotations across four datasets comprising human plasma and mouse feces analyzed in positive and negative ionization modes. The plasma assay libraries contained 199 target lipids in positive mode and 147 in negative mode. The fecal assay libraries contained 181 target lipids in positive mode and 264 in negative mode. At a 5% false discovery rate (FDR) threshold, OpenLipid identified 110 (55.3%) and 28 (19.0%) library targets in plasma and 130 (71.8%) and 84 (31.8%) in feces, in positive and negative ionization modes, respectively. OpenLipid achieved an overall identification rate comparable to that of DIAMetAlyzer (57.8%, 19.7%, 89.0%, and 17.8% across the corresponding datasets) and substantially higher than that of untargeted MS-DIAL DIA analysis (12.6%, 0.0%, 47.5%, and 0.0%) on the same assay-library targets. LLM-derived chromatographic features also enabled supervised discrimination between correct and incorrect candidate peak groups for target lipids, with median cross-validation average precision values of 0.838-0.912. Together, these results demonstrate that OpenLipid is an effective LLM-based workflow for FDR-controlled targeted analysis of DIA lipidomics data.
items.summary_zh: OpenLipid 用 LLM 在零样本条件下解释 DIA 色谱图，并在四个血浆和鼠粪便脂质组数据集上与人工注释和现有流程比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作同时报告 FDR 控制的目标脂质鉴定率和可读理由，显示 LLM 可进入分析质谱的可审计决策环节。
items.abstract_zh: 质谱已成为脂质组学的核心技术，数据非依赖采集（DIA）能够对脂质信号进行广泛且可重复的采样。然而，DIA 数据中多重化的碎片离子谱使脂质鉴定变得复杂。本文提出 OpenLipid：一个用于靶向 DIA 脂质组学的大语言模型（LLM）工作流。利用从数据依赖采集（DDA）结果构建的分析库，OpenLipid 在零样本设置下直接评估 DIA 数据中的提取离子色谱图（XICs），以鉴定目标脂质峰，并为单个脂质鉴定决策生成可供人阅读的理由。我们在四个数据集上将 OpenLipid 与人工注释进行基准比较；这些数据集包括在正、负离子模式下分析的人血浆和小鼠粪便。血浆分析库在正离子模式下包含 199 种目标脂质，在负离子模式下包含 147 种。粪便分析库在正离子模式下包含 181 种目标脂质，在负离子模式下包含 264 种。在 5% 假发现率（FDR）阈值下，OpenLipid 在血浆中分别鉴定出 110 种（55.3%）和 28 种（19.0%）库内靶标，在粪便中分别鉴定出 130 种（71.8%）和 84 种（31.8%）库内靶标，顺序对应正、负离子模式。对于相同分析库靶标，OpenLipid 的总体鉴定率与 DIAMetAlyzer 相当（相应四个数据集分别为 57.8%、19.7%、89.0% 和 17.8%），并显著高于非靶向 MS-DIAL DIA 分析（分别为 12.6%、0.0%、47.5% 和 0.0%）。LLM 衍生的色谱特征还使得能够对目标脂质的正确和错误候选峰组进行监督判别，其中交叉验证平均精确率的中位数为 0.838–0.912。总体而言，这些结果表明，OpenLipid 是一个有效的、基于 LLM 的工作流，可用于 FDR 控制的 DIA 脂质组学靶向分析。

items.title: AI agents at the brain-computer interface: separating inference from control
items.abstract_or_text: In medicine, AI agents are moving from generating text to executing actions, making uncertainty from upstream decoders a control problem. We studied this at the brain-computer interface using 1,065 episodes from 47 people with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and five language models. Prompting agents with reconstructed decoder confidence never reduced unfaithful execution below a deterministic gate at matched coverage; two models were significantly worse. Apparent safety gains of up to 22 percentage points reflected acting less often, sometimes through invalid tool calls rather than explicit abstention. A post-hoc fair-information test gave ten models the same command vocabulary as a deterministic resolver. No direct agent arm improved on the resolver's risk-coverage frontier, but a hybrid architecture in which models proposed semantic corrections and an external gate retained admission authority extended coverage beyond the resolver in five of ten models without observed unfaithful executions. These results separate inference from control in agentic neurotechnology. Funding: A.G. and E.K. were supported in part by the Clinical and Translational Science Awards (CTSA) grant UL1TR002541 from the National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences, through the Harvard Catalyst | The Harvard Clinical and Translational Science Center Pilot Award Program. items.summary_zh: 在 47 名 ALS 患者的 1,065 个脑机接口片段上，研究显示直接由语言模型执行控制未超越确定性门控；混合门控架构在部分模型中扩展了覆盖范围。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对医疗代理的安全性评估直接比较风险-覆盖权衡，并区分语义推断与行动准入；该结果不构成临床部署有效性证明。
items.abstract_zh: 在医学中，AI 代理正从生成文本转向执行行动，使上游解码器的不确定性成为一个控制问题。我们使用来自 47 名肌萎缩侧索硬化症患者的 1,065 个片段和五个语言模型，在脑机接口中研究这一问题。在相同覆盖率下，向代理提示重建的解码器置信度，从未将不忠实执行降低至确定性门控以下；其中两个模型显著更差。表面上最高达 22 个百分点的安全性提升，反映的是更少地采取行动，有时是通过无效工具调用而非明确弃权实现的。一项事后公平信息测试赋予十个模型与确定性解析器相同的命令词汇表。没有任何直接代理组优于该解析器的风险-覆盖率前沿；但在一种混合架构中，模型提出语义纠正，外部门控保留准入权限，在十个模型中的五个里将覆盖率扩展到解析器之外，且未观察到不忠实执行。这些结果将代理型神经技术中的推断与控制区分开来。资金支持：A.G. 和 E.K. 部分得到美国国家转化科学促进中心（National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences）临床与转化科学奖（CTSA）UL1TR002541 的支持，该资助经由 Harvard Catalyst | The Harvard Clinical and Translational Science Center Pilot Award Program 提供。文中内容仅代表作者责任，并不必然代表美国国立卫生研究院的官方观点。
